title: Istio配置实操：交付90/10灰度路由并用真实istioctl本地分析核验子集关系
body:
## 操作任务
仅修改routing.yaml：在mesh-training命名空间给reviews服务交付DestinationRule的v1/v2子集，分别映射version=v1/v2；VirtualService绑定完整服务域名reviews.mesh-training.svc.cluster.local，唯一HTTP规则approved-split只路由到端口80，v1权重90、v2权重10。保持base.yaml原样，不能增加其他路由、匹配条件、镜像或副作用。

## 产物
routing.yaml；base.yaml为固定命名空间、Service和双版本工作负载素材。

## 验收方法
实际运行istioctl1.31.3 analyze --use-kube=false，随后核对批准权重、目标端口、子集标签和作用域。只在自有user/net namespace内做本地配置分析，显式空kubeconfig；不连接集群或产生业务流量。素材不安装，镜像名仅为本地资源模型字段，无构建或拉取。配置通过不等于生产灰度流量已按比例执行。
explanation: VirtualService选择流量分配，DestinationRule定义命名子集和工作负载标签。先以完整服务域名和明确命名空间消除解析歧义，再用真实分析器核对引用关系；批准权重还需独立核验，语法可通过的50/50不是题设要求的90/10。
rubric: 真实本地分析器通过，批准的90/10和v1/v2标签及端口一致；保持固定素材和作用域。
review_note: 真实实操缺口绑定冻结空名额；五路原生与浏览器证据另存，新题号单列，不当旧题改编，不算原214项故障。

exercise.environment: 既有私有WSL普通student；istioctl1.31.3在自有user/net namespace中本地分析，显式空kubeconfig
exercise.operation: 交付批准的Istio路由和子集资源，用真实本地分析器核验，再核对业务权重合同。
exercise.validation_scope: 本地配置与引用关系实操；无集群安装、业务流量或运行时灰度验证，无镜像构建和拉取。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile,yaml
assert os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
base=pathlib.Path('base.yaml');routing=pathlib.Path('routing.yaml')
assert hashlib.sha256(base.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='174942024b34cb93a54a3b9808416cd695dab7a2d9ab8cfa9d224bba9d2db1f7','fixed namespace/service/workload material changed'
raw=routing.read_text(encoding='utf8')
if raw.strip()=='# IMPLEMENT_APPROVED_CANARY':raise NotImplementedError('complete the approved Istio configuration')
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:actual_istioctl_local_resource_analysis',flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-istio-offline-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);config=root/'kubeconfig.json';config.write_text(json.dumps({'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Config','clusters':[],'contexts':[],'users':[],'current-context':''}))
 env={**os.environ,'KUBECONFIG':str(config),'ISTIO_CONFIG_DIR':str(root/'config'),'GOMAXPROCS':'2','GOMEMLIMIT':'384MiB'}
 command=['unshare','-Urn','--','istioctl','analyze','--use-kube=false','--kubeconfig',str(config),'--namespace','mesh-training','--failure-threshold','Error',str(base.resolve()),str(routing.resolve())]
 result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=20)
 print('ISTIOCTL_LOCAL_ANALYSIS_RETURN',result.returncode,flush=True)
 assert result.returncode==0,result.stdout+result.stderr
docs=list(yaml.safe_load_all(raw));assert len(docs)==2 and {d['kind'] for d in docs}=={'DestinationRule','VirtualService'}
for d in docs:assert d['apiVersion']=='networking.istio.io/v1' and d['metadata']=={'name':'reviews','namespace':'mesh-training'}
dr=next(d for d in docs if d['kind']=='DestinationRule');vs=next(d for d in docs if d['kind']=='VirtualService')
host='reviews.mesh-training.svc.cluster.local';assert set(dr['spec'])=={'host','subsets'} and dr['spec']['host']==host
assert dr['spec']['subsets']==[{'name':'v1','labels':{'version':'v1'}},{'name':'v2','labels':{'version':'v2'}}]
assert set(vs['spec'])=={'hosts','http'} and vs['spec']['hosts']==[host] and len(vs['spec']['http'])==1
rule=vs['spec']['http'][0];assert set(rule)=={'name','route'} and rule['name']=='approved-split' and len(rule['route'])==2
routes=rule['route'];assert all(type(r.get('weight')) is int for r in routes) and sum(r['weight'] for r in routes)==100
assert routes==[{'destination':{'host':host,'subset':'v1','port':{'number':80}},'weight':90},{'destination':{'host':host,'subset':'v2','port':{'number':80}},'weight':10}],'approved split must be stable90/canary10, without extra destinations or side effects'
assert hashlib.sha256(base.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='174942024b34cb93a54a3b9808416cd695dab7a2d9ab8cfa9d224bba9d2db1f7'
print('NATIVE_ISTIOCTL_REAL_LOCAL_ANALYZER_APPROVED_90_10_SPLIT_SUBSET_LABELS_FQDN_AND_NAMESPACE_NO_CLUSTER_NETWORK',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
